prior.semantics: registered product prior over the frozen 3x3 stiffness-damping bank

query.name: tail_centered_shape_rms_deformation
query.partition_rule: sorted hypothesis-query values split at 3/9 and 6/9 rank boundaries; a boundary inside a numerical tie is omitted
query.interpretation: low, middle, or high nonrigid deformation regime under the registered twisting input

scoring.trajectory_score: finite-distribution energy score normalized by square root of evaluated coordinate dimension

controls.wrong_specimen_rule: cyclic next specimen in lexicographic material-size order
controls.identity_control_rule: reverse the frozen 3x3 parameter-bank identity before quotient aggregation

analysis.inferential_unit: eight material-size specimens, with four target conditions averaged within specimen

evidence_class: retrospective public-real-data query-quotient validation; prior target exposure not assumed absent; no fresh-confirmation claim
claim_boundary: This study tests a registered query quotient, Jeffrey I-projection, unsupported specificity, ambiguity, and source-to-target transport on public cloth trajectories. It does not establish unique material identity, command-conditioned intervention effects, calibrated joint trajectory uncertainty, unseen-object generalization, safety, or a fresh confirmatory result.
